question: P invested a certain amount in shares. The shares rose successively by 20% and 30% on two consecutive days and fell by 25% and 11% in the next two days. What is the percentage increase or decrease in the value of the shares in four days?
solution:
**Given:**

The shares rose successively by 20% and 30% on two consecutive days and fell by 25% and 11% in the next two days.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage increase or decrease = ((Final Value - Initial Value) / Initial Value) × 100 %
